description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 (admin/admin). Following the board-approved Q2 organisational restructuring, the Long Term Projects division is being dissolved and its personnel absorbed into Research & Development. The restructuring plan is logged as a note in the Research & Development department record in Odoo — refer to it to determine the correct assignments for each affected employee. Execute the full merger: transfer all Long Term Projects employees to Research & Development according to the plan (updating their job positions and direct reporting lines as specified in the memo), update the R&D department's management structure accordingly, and archive the Long Term Projects department once it has been fully vacated. Ensure the changes exactly match the plan documented in Odoo.
